facts.fact: 断臂自接：她按自己学的法子立即校正断骨（不等对齐）——呕吐、尖叫、尽快愈合；Draven 从地面一把捞起（未减速）、听到她尖叫的血赋成为「massive burden」；「Viper」新称呼诞生（「I've nothing to learn, Viper」）
facts.anchor: breaks will heal quickly if I don’t wait to line the bones back up

facts.fact: 她的回敬：「我宁可背弃全世界也不会让你冒一刻险」；他的誓词升级：「If upholding my Marked Match takes my life, I'm honored to pay the price…You belong to me now」——「whose will is stronger」的对峙
facts.anchor: I’d forsake the whole fucking world before I risked you for even a moment.

facts.fact: 弓箭手瞄准：Alden 与 Evelyn 相望一眼（隔着她的盾）——决别的微笑；「We. Are. Stuck.」——移动目标反而更难打中，但他们卡在射界里
她碎了：onyx Brinden Stone 在胸口炸裂——轰鸣回荡大地、长刺扎进血肉骨骼；失聪、剧痛覆盖一切感官；身体把碎片往里拉（「effectively pulling them in」）
facts.anchor: My amulet bursts where it sits on my chest

facts.fact: 虹彩波：无方向的波从她体内以闪电速度射向森林——弓箭手、马、树木全部点燃熔化（「They didn't even have enough time to scream before they melted」）——「I caused this?」
facts.anchor: waves—iridescent in color, like a mirage—emanate from my body

facts.fact: 信号塔连锁点燃：全国每一座塔都在报 Dranderon 入侵——「More specifically, King Hayden's fire. My fire.」——护符里的火之力（ch02 缴获的 Hayden 之石）在她体内暴走
